title: Let the Name clear the fog
summary: This meets the inner confusion that keeps reopening what was already shown. The line says the Guru plants Naam so doubt loses its house and the path brightens.
takeaway: Let Naam clear what doubt clouds.
lifeApplication: Before chasing another explanation, return to the line and sing one praise. Stay with the light already given until the next step is visible.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru plants Naam so doubt gives way to light and direction.
